- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥ 0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next period.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2–4% above recent high.
- If sentiment turns negative (≤ 0.33) and price is rising, model may lag; adjust forecast downward by 1–2% for next 2–3 periods.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30d horizon when sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67); model often overreacts; apply 1–2% downward correction if recent 5d avg is > 10% above 30d avg.
- If model forecast is > 2% above true outcome for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1% per day until convergence.
- When sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and price is trending, model often misses the turn; add 0.5–1% downward bias for next 3 periods.
- For 30d horizon, if true outcome is > 10% above 18d history, model tends to overfit; apply 1–2% downward correction to avoid overestimation.
